customManagers.description: Tool versions pinned as env vars in CI workflows. The github-actions manager only looks at `uses:` lines, so these need their own manager. Annotate a variable with a `# renovate: datasource=... depName=... [extractVersion=...]` comment on the line above it. extractVersion is set per annotation because the tag formats differ (vX.Y.Z, kustomize/vX.Y.Z, none on PyPI).

packageRules.description: The docker datasource returns no release timestamp for ghcr.io tags, and minimumReleaseAgeBehaviour defaults to timestamp-required, so the minimumReleaseAge soak above kept every ghcr.io update (immich, bulwark) pending forever. Treat a missing timestamp as stable; tags that do carry one still wait.

Pin every container image to its digest (tag@sha256:...). A tag is mutable: patch and minor updates are automerged and Flux applies main within the minute, so a tag re-pushed upstream would reach the cluster unreviewed. With the digest, Renovate opens a `digest` PR instead (automerged above), visible in the history.

Our own image, bumped by hand (chore(personal-website-v2): bump image to X). A hand edit that changes only the tag would keep the old digest, and the kubelet pulls by digest: the old image would stay deployed with no error. Leave it tag-only.

The authentik backup and restore-verify images must keep the PostgreSQL major of the server deployed by the authentik chart (17): a newer pg_dump writes archives the server's pg_restore 17 cannot read, so a real restore would fail. Patch and minor 17.x updates still flow. Lift this together with the server's major.
